title: Input Action Definition Schema
description: Based on UGAS Specification v1.0.0-draft.6 - Section 11

Name.description: Unique identifier for this action, referenced by InputID on granted abilities

ValueType.description: Semantic value type this action produces. Digital actions emit trigger events (Started/Ongoing/Completed). Axis actions emit a continuous value each frame while nonzero.

TriggerBehavior.description: When this action fires its trigger event. OnPressed fires once on activation. WhileHeld fires every frame while input is nonzero. OnTap requires press-then-release within TapThreshold.

TapThreshold.description: Maximum hold duration (seconds) for OnTap and OnDoubleTap

DoubleTapWindow.description: Maximum gap (seconds) between two taps for OnDoubleTap

ConsumeInput.description: Whether this action consumes the input event, preventing lower-priority actions from receiving it

ActionTags.description: Tags describing this action for bulk queries (e.g. disable all combat inputs)

DisplayName.description: Localization-friendly name shown in control remapping UI

Category.description: UI grouping for settings screens (e.g. Movement, Combat)
